behaviors.behavior: A write at/under the chunk cap is forwarded as a single, unmodified pty.write call (no behavior change for the common case)
behaviors.evidence: pty-manager.test.ts: 'a write at/under the chunk cap is forwarded as a single, unmodified pty.write call'

behaviors.behavior: An oversized single-burst write (6KB repro) is split into sub-cap chunks that reconstruct the exact original bytes
behaviors.evidence: pty-write-chunker.test.ts: 'an oversized single-burst write (repro: 6 KB launch command) is split into sub-cap chunks...'

behaviors.behavior: chunkUtf8ForPtyWrite never splits a multi-byte UTF-8 sequence across a chunk boundary
behaviors.evidence: pty-write-chunker.test.ts: 'never splits a multi-byte UTF-8 sequence across a chunk boundary'

behaviors.behavior: chunkUtf8ForPtyWrite terminates and round-trips exactly for a misconfigured maxBytes <= 0 (would otherwise hang forever)
behaviors.evidence: pty-write-chunker.test.ts: it.each([0,-5,1,2,3]) 'terminates and round-trips exactly when maxBytes=%d (clamped to a 4-byte floor)'

behaviors.behavior: The default scheduler yields real event-loop turns between chunks (not one synchronous burst)
behaviors.evidence: pty-write-chunker.test.ts: 'the default scheduler yields real event-loop turns between chunks...' (vi.useFakeTimers)

behaviors.behavior: A task killed mid-chunked-write stops delivering the remaining chunks
behaviors.evidence: pty-manager.test.ts: 'a task killed mid-chunked-write stops delivering the remaining chunks'

behaviors.behavior: A respawn for the same taskId after a kill-mid-drain starts with a clean write queue
behaviors.evidence: pty-manager.test.ts: 'a respawn for the same taskId after a kill-mid-drain starts with a clean write queue...'

behaviors.behavior: A second (small) write arriving mid-drain is queued, not interleaved, behind the in-flight chunked write
behaviors.evidence: pty-write-chunker.test.ts: 'a write arriving mid-drain is queued, not interleaved, behind the in-flight chunked write'

behaviors.behavior: A second oversized write queued mid-drain is itself chunked once its turn comes
behaviors.evidence: pty-write-chunker.test.ts: 'a second oversized write queued mid-drain is itself chunked once its turn comes'

behaviors.behavior: A mouse report (writeMouseReport) arriving mid-drain is queued behind the in-flight burst, not spliced into it
behaviors.evidence: pty-manager.test.ts: 'a mouse report arriving mid-drain is queued behind the in-flight burst, not spliced into it'

behaviors.behavior: A write that would exceed the pendingWrites byte cap is dropped whole, without corrupting the already-queued writes
behaviors.evidence: pty-write-chunker.test.ts: 'a write that would exceed the pendingWrites byte cap is dropped whole...'

behaviors.behavior: Draining a very large queue of small writes does not overflow the call stack, and preserves delivery order (external Tier-3 PR review finding: the drain was mutually recursive with deliverOrChunk, one stack frame per queued write)
behaviors.evidence: pty-write-chunker.test.ts: 'draining a very large queue of small writes does not overflow the stack, and preserves delivery order' (20,000-entry queue)

behaviors.behavior: The original macOS production failure (canonical-mode tty input-queue deadlock on an oversized single pty write) is closed on a real macOS shell
behaviors.reason: This dev environment is Windows (node-pty -> ConPTY), which does not reproduce macOS's termios canonical-mode input-queue behavior; needs a real macOS tester per the operator's own plan.
